title: NeMo Eval Author audit coverage report
description: Shared per-trace coverage result consumed by audit coverage aggregation. This file records which stable audit item names one measurement method covered for one measured subject.

schema.description: Version marker for the shared audit coverage format.

audit.description: Audit spec metadata for the denominator used by this measurement.

subject.description: Provider-neutral identity of the measured task/run artifact.

method.description: Measurement method that produced this coverage file.

item_kind.description: Audit item kind this coverage file covers.

item_kind_count.description: Number of audit items in the denominator with this item_kind. Aggregators use this as the method-specific denominator.

covered.description: Stable audit item names this trace covered according to the selected method.

nonEmptyString.description: String value that must contain at least one non-whitespace character.

itemName.description: Stable machine-readable audit item or tool name.

pathString.description: Local file or directory path recorded as a string.

audit.description: Identity and status of the audit denominator used for this measurement. Aggregators use this to detect mixed agents, draft denominators, or reports produced against different audit files.

path.description: Path to the audit.md file measured against.

schema.description: Schema version of the audit denominator.

agent.description: Agent name declared by the audit denominator.

status.description: Review state of the audit denominator when this measurement was produced.

item_count.description: Number of audit items in the denominator when this measurement was produced.

subject.description: The measured task or run. Keep this provider-neutral so aggregation can group coverage without understanding the runner that produced the trace.

trace.description: Path to the interaction trace that was measured.

trace_format.description: Trace serialization format understood by the measurement method.

task_id.description: Stable task, scenario, or case identifier for grouping measurements.

run_id.description: Identifier for the specific run, trial, attempt, or repetition measured.
